Container.Name: ferrumc
Container.Overview: FerrumC Minecraft Java 1.21.8 (experimental alpha) with an extended native-style dashboard: authenticated console, live metrics, player management, bans, whitelist, config editor and server start/stop/restart. Set a dashboard password (12+ characters), or read the generated password in appdata/dashboard-password.txt. UI-saved settings override template defaults. Persistent files in /data.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent world, configs, whitelist and logs.

Config.Name: Dashboard port
Config.Description: Live dashboard, trusted LAN/VPN only. Internal port remains 9000.

Config.Name: Dashboard password
Config.Description: At least 12 characters. Empty: generate appdata/dashboard-password.txt. Use LAN/VPN or an HTTPS reverse proxy.

Config.Name: Server message
Config.Description: Server list message; initial default until settings are saved in the dashboard.

Config.Name: Maximum players
Config.Description: 1-10000; initial default until settings are saved in the dashboard.

Config.Name: View distance
Config.Description: 2-32 chunks; initial default until settings are saved in the dashboard.

Config.Name: Gamemode
Config.Description: Creative recommended; FerrumC does not provide full survival gameplay.

Config.Name: Whitelist
Config.Description: Enable after configuring /data/whitelist.txt using the upstream UUID format.
